## PR checklist

- [ ] Fill in description of the PR and link to any relevant issues.
- [ ] If you've fixed a bug or added code that should be tested, add tests!
- [ ] If you've added a new tool, follow the pipeline conventions in the [contribution docs](https://github.com/genomic-medicine-sweden/nallo/tree/master/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Usage Documentation in `docs/usage.md` is updated.
- [ ] Output Documentation in `docs/output.md` is updated.
- [ ] `README.md` is updated (including new tools and authors/contributors).
